title: Sophos: security-alert triage and response from Teams
availability: Listed partner integration; no live tenant verification
overview: Microsoft describes Sophos security alerts, triage and response actions in Microsoft 365, allowing security teams to work from Teams rather than a separate console. The model uses a generic documented response operation, not an invented endpoint-isolation command.
published_facts: Sophos alerts and threat notifications can surface in Teams.
Security teams can triage and respond to incidents from Microsoft 365.
Agent activity is described as tracked in the admin-center observability dashboard.

sources.title: Ecosystem partner agents available in Agent 365 - Sophos
sources.verification: Primary page and Sophos section fetched and read directly.

a365_relationship: Direct: Microsoft explicitly names the Sophos Agent 365 integration.
intent: Receive a security alert in Teams, triage the incident and carry out an authorized response.
actors: Security analyst, Sophos agent and incident target; one abstract Agent role.
published_outcome: Documented in-Teams incident-response capability, not measured prevention or remediation effectiveness.

actions.description: Receive the Sophos security alert or threat notification.
Triage the incident using its alert context.
Execute an authorized incident response from the Microsoft 365 workflow.

local_assumptions: The response capability is intentionally abstract because the source does not enumerate concrete response commands.
Independent approval of the exact response content and target is a local policy, not a documented Sophos requirement.
All alert and target data are synthetic; the transport never contacts an endpoint.
limitations: The checker cannot determine whether an alert is a real threat or whether the selected response is effective.
Authorization for a specific destructive response must be supplied by a real policy and tool adapter.
No live incident handling, endpoint isolation or remediation was performed.

runtime_model.source_fixture: Synthetic security alert without addresses or credentials.
